description: Source code for DETR object detection model and associated loss functions, post-processing, and model building functions.

classes.name: DETR
classes.description: Object detection model class implementing the DETR architecture with transformer and backbone integration.

classes.name: SetCriterion
classes.description: Loss computation class for training DETR, including classification, bounding box, and mask losses.

classes.name: PostProcess
classes.description: Converts raw model outputs into COCO API compatible format.

classes.name: MLP
classes.description: Multi-layer perceptron used for bounding box embedding.

methods.name: _set_aux_loss
methods.description: Creates auxiliary outputs for intermediate decoder layers during training.

methods.name: loss_labels
methods.description: Computes classification loss (cross-entropy) for object classes.

methods.name: loss_cardinality
methods.description: Computes the error in the number of predicted non-empty boxes for logging.

methods.name: loss_boxes
methods.description: Computes bounding box regression losses including L1 and GIoU.

methods.name: loss_masks
methods.description: Computes mask-related losses: focal loss and dice loss.

methods.name: get_loss
methods.description: Retrieves specific loss function based on loss name.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Performs the overall loss computation during training.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Performs post-processing to convert model outputs into COCO format.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Performs the forward pass of the DETR model, returning predictions.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the DETR model, criterion, and postprocessors based on input arguments.
